viva.question: Is Brownian motion differentiable?
viva.answer: No — almost surely nowhere differentiable, despite being continuous everywhere.
viva.why: The difference quotient's standard deviation blows up like 1/sqrt(h) as h\to0.
viva.followUp: What single fact forces the existence of Ito calculus?
viva.trap: Assuming continuous implies mostly differentiable, as with typical calculus functions.

viva.question: Why can't information in a filtration decrease over time?
viva.answer: Once observed, information can't be unobserved — F_s \subseteq F_t for s\le t encodes this.
viva.why: Every question answerable at time s using F_s must still be answerable at time t using F_t.
viva.followUp: What's the smallest sigma-algebra on any sample space?
viva.trap: Assuming sigma(A) for a single event A is just {A}.
